content:
mina: noticed oscillation after we added probation windows. tenants get probated -> retry quickly -> probation reapplied. want a compact decision w/ safe defaults. :thinking:

ryan: yep. root cause is zero-hysteresis: probation ends immediately at timer expiry and clients hammer back. need a cooldown + staggered ramp.

joel: concrete: change probation to three phases: soft (p-drop), limbo (reduced concurrency), recovery (ramped increase). timers: soft=60s, limbo=180s, recovery=5m with linear ramp.

anya: add random jitter to recovery start (0-30s) per-tenant to avoid synchronized restarts. also care about reserved tenants: always go to alert path, never p-drop.

bot-deploy: deploy: probation-phases-v1 rolled to canary at 2026-01-08T11:12Z :rocket:

keisha: telemetry + alerts: probation_entries, phase_transitions, recovery_failures. alert if recovery_failures > 0.2%/5m. also create dashboard with phase counts by tenant weight.

mina: decision: implement phases + jitter + cooldown multiplier; eng-platform owns RFC + rollout, eng-sre owns runbook. i'll send RFC PR with config snippet and tests.
